people.name: Jeremiah
people.line: Son of Hilkiah, the prophet during Judah's final days.

people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: So Jeremiah stayed in the court of the guard until the day that Jerusalem was taken.
translations.bsb: And Jeremiah remained in the courtyard of the guard until the day Jerusalem was captured.
translations.kjv: So Jeremiah abode in the court of the prison until the day that Jerusalem was taken: and he was there when Jerusalem was taken.
translations.asv: So Jeremiah abode in the court of the guard until the day that Jerusalem was taken.
